notes: Agent screen fix: tapping Claude Code or Antigravity when not installed now offers the install right on the spot with live download progress and switches to the agent on success; install failures show their reason. Antigravity parity: a failed task's changed files stay in the Changes tab and a prompt started right after Stop can no longer lose its Stop button or notification. Reliability: emoji/CJK characters no longer corrupt session output at 16 KB read boundaries, concurrent liveness checks can no longer turn success into a bogus -138 failure, agent updates roll back automatically when verification fails and understand pre-release versions, and a failed spawn surfaces a proper error instead of a bare crash. Runtime bundle downloads and the privacy policy URL now come from the ferdausfs repository. Same signing key - installs directly over v1.0.9/v1.0.10.
